class FeatureNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.layer1 = nn.Linear(12, 12)
        self.layer2 = nn.Linear(12, 16)
        self.layer3 = nn.Linear(16, 48)
        self.layer4 = nn.Linear(48, 64)
        self.layer5 = nn.Linear(64, 4)

        h6 = F.sigmoid(h5)
        h7 = self.layer4(h6)
        h8 = F.sigmoid(h7)
        h9 = self.layer5(h8)
        return h9

        x = F.sigmoid(x)
        x = self.mix(x)
        x = F.sigmoid(x)
        x = self.merge(x)
        x = self.post(x)
        x = self.decode(x)
        return x

        x = x + b

        b = self.stem(h3)
        left = self.head(h3)
        h4 = v + b
        h5 = h4 + left
        h6 = self.encode(h5)

        h4 = self.fc1(h3)
        h5 = F.tanh(h4)
        h6 = self.fc2(h5)
        h7 = h6 + h2
        return h7

        h = self.stem(h)
        h = torch.cat([h, h], dim=1)
        h = self.shrink(h)
        h = self.body(h)
        h = self.neck(h)
        h = self.tail(h)
        h = self.post(h)
        return h

        h4 = self.fc_1(h3)
        h5 = F.gelu(h4)

        x = fn.sigmoid(x)
        x = self.p1(x)
        x = self.f1(x)

class TinyModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.post = nn.Conv2d(3, 8, 3, padding=1)
        self.decode = nn.ReLU()

        x = self.decode(x)
        a = self.stem(x)
        c = self.merge(x)
        left = self.proj(x)
        x = torch.cat([a, c, left], dim=1)
        x = self.encode(x)
        x = self.shrink(x)
        x = self.pre(x)
        x = self.tail(x)
        return x

        self.c4 = nn.Conv2d(32, 32, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.c5 = nn.Conv2d(32, 32, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.c6 = nn.Conv2d(32, 32, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.b2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(32)
        self.c7 = nn.Conv2d(32, 32, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.p1 = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.f1 = nn.Flatten()
        self.f1_2 = nn.Linear(32, 2, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.c1(x)
        x = self.a1(x)
        # residual block
        x = self.c2(x)
        x = self.b1(x)
        x = self.a1(x)
        x = self.c3(x)
        x = x + x
        x = self.a1(x)
        # residual block

        x = self.a1(x)
        x = self.c5(x)
        x = x + x
        x = self.a1(x)
        # residual block

        x = self.b2(x)
        x = self.a1(x)
        x = self.c7(x)
        x = x + x
        x = self.a1(x)
        x = self.p1(x)
        x = self.f1(x)
        x = self.f1_2(x)
        return x

    def __init__(self):
        super(SmallNet, self).__init__()
        self.conv_1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.act_1 = nn.GELU()
        self.down_1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.conv_2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 32, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.up_1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2)
        self.conv_3 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1, bias=False)

        x = self.act_1(x)
        x = self.pool_1(x)
        x = self.flat_1(x)
        x = self.fc_1(x)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Backbone(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        """Backbone built for the graph task."""
        super().__init__()
        self.encode = nn.Conv2d(3, 8, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 1, padding=0)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 3, padding=1)
        self.gate = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 5, padding=2)
        self.expand = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.pre = nn.Flatten()
        self.decode = nn.Linear(24, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.encode(x)
        h2 = F.silu(h1)
        # three parallel branches
        left = self.mix(h2)
        p = self.proj(h2)
        u = self.gate(h2)
        h3 = torch.cat([left, p, u], dim=1)
        h4 = F.silu(h3)
        h5 = self.expand(h4)
        h6 = self.pre(h5)
        h7 = self.decode(h6)
        return h7

class Classifier(nn.Module):

        """Classifier built for the graph task."""
        super(Classifier, self).__init__()
        self.tail = nn.LayerNorm(16)

        x = self.encode(x)
        x = self.pre(x)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = self.head(x)
        x = x + x

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


class MyNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.pre = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.head = nn.GELU()
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 1, padding=0, bias=False)
        self.post = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.expand = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 5, padding=2, bias=False)
        self.tail = nn.GELU()
        self.encode = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.mix = nn.Flatten()
        self.decode = nn.Linear(48, 10, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.pre(x)
        h2 = self.head(h1)
        v = self.stem(h2)
        q = self.post(h2)
        c = self.expand(h2)
        h3 = torch.cat([v, q, c], dim=1)
        h4 = self.tail(h3)
        h5 = self.encode(h4)
        h6 = self.mix(h5)
        h7 = self.decode(h6)
        return h7
